payload.title: Auto-refresh the tasks-snapshot projection on claim push
payload.body: The push:[tasks-claims] trigger is impossible on github.com Actions (orphan log branch has no workflows), so the projection now runs on schedule + workflow_dispatch only — claims don't refresh TASKS.md until the next cron tick. Add near-real-time refresh: have the git-native backend fire a repository_dispatch (event-type tasks-claims-updated) after a successful claims push, and add that trigger to tasks-snapshot.yml. Surfaced finishing the dogfood projection 2026-06-03.
